data.missing_policy: Any missing or stale required observation makes the decision ineligible; no forward filling.

stage_1.funding_feature: negative mean of the three latest already-settled funding rates
stage_1.premium_feature: negative median close of the eight latest completed 30-minute premium-index bars
stage_1.positioning_feature: negative log of the latest available global account long/short ratio (count_long_short_ratio)
stage_1.oi_buildup_feature: six-hour log change in BTC-denominated sum_open_interest
stage_1.price_resistance_rule: six-hour spot return > -0.5 times six-hour realized volatility
stage_1.realized_volatility: square root of summed squared five-minute close-to-close log returns

stage_2.spot_taker_buy_ratio: sum(taker_buy_base_volume) / sum(volume) over the latest completed hour
stage_2.breakout: latest completed five-minute close strictly above the maximum high in the preceding four hours, excluding the confirmation hour

analogue_model.short_crowding_score: mean strict-trailing percentile rank of the three transformed crowding features
analogue_model.price_resistance: six-hour spot return divided by six-hour realized volatility
analogue_model.oi_contraction_1h: negative one-hour log change in BTC-denominated open interest
analogue_model.volatility_expansion: log(one-hour realized volatility / (six-hour realized volatility / sqrt(6)))
analogue_model.normalization: Current-window median and MAD using only valid decisions in the preceding 180 calendar days
analogue_model.distance: unweighted Euclidean distance after robust normalization
analogue_model.outcome: gross BTCUSDT spot return from the next five-minute boundary open to the open six hours later

execution.stop_gap_policy: If a five-minute bar opens below the stop, use the bar open; otherwise use the stop.
execution.cost_model: Half the round-trip cost is applied adversely and multiplicatively to each entry and exit fill.

trial_accounting.holdout_policy: Do not evaluate a later partition unless every gate in the preceding partition passes without specification changes.
